title: Magical Tools and Weapons
description:
There are quite a few different weapons in the arsenal of a sorcerer:
- Enchanter's Wand casts projectile spells, allowing to exceed the glyph cap a little,
- Enchanter's Mirror does the same with self spells,
- Enchanter's Sword casts Touch spells with increased damage,
- Enchanter's Gauntlet also casts with Touch and is a diamond-tier multitool,
- Enchanter's Fishing Rod casts a touch spell on the hooked entity §ocontinuously§r,
- Enchanter's Bow shoots arrows imbued with spells,
- Enchanter's Shield gives Mana Regeneration and Spell Damage when used,
- and the Splash Flask Cannon fires potions!
